info.title: ConvertAPI
info.description:
# High-Performance File Conversion API
Convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, PDF and Image formats with our powerful file conversion service.
We support more than [200 file types.]( https://www.convertapi.com/doc/file-formats)

pdf.name: pdf
pdf.metaDescription: Convert PDF documents to DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX programmatically using a fast REST API conversion service. Easily turn PDF documents into editable files.
pdf.summary: The API for converting and manipulating PDF files
pdf.description: Convert your PDF documents to DOCX, PPTX, or XLSX files programmatically using our fast and secure REST API conversion service. With this API you can easily convert textual and scanned PDF documents to a Word, PowerPoint, Excel, or plain text file, extract tables from textual and scanned PDF documents to comma-separated values CSV files as well as MS Office spreadsheets, and generate editable Powerpoint presentations.

pdfa.name: pdfa
pdfa.metaDescription: The API for converting various types of documents like MS Word and PDF files to standardized PDF/A-1b, PDF/A-2b, and PDF/A-3b files for long-term storage.
pdfa.summary: Convert various documents to a standardized PDF/A format
pdfa.description: PDF/A is a standardized format for the long-term archiving and preservation of electronic documents. It ensures content integrity and accessibility for proper rendering between different software platforms. Our service provides API tools for converting various types of documents like MS Word and PDF files to PDF/A-1b, PDF/A-2b, and PDF/A-3b files for long-term storage.

postscript.name: postscript
postscript.metaDescription: Secure and reliable PostScript conversion REST API service, providing EPS, PRN, and PS file conversions to PDF or image formats like JPEG, PNG, TIFF, or WEBP.
postscript.description: Secure and reliable PostScript conversion REST API service, providing EPS, PRN, and PS file conversions to PDF or image formats like JPEG, PNG, TIFF, or WEBP. Each conversion provides a bunch of useful conversion properties. Convert your PostScript documents with any programming language at ease using our fast and scalable conversion service.

modify.name: modify
modify.metaDescription: Apply document modifications to PDF documents, such as delete or rotate PDF pages, split or merge PDF documents using our fast and secure REST APIs.
modify.summary: Modify PDF documents using our fast and secure REST APIs
modify.description: Remove unnecessary pages, adjust the orientation, or manage the document structure using our REST API. Deleting pages from a PDF is simple and precise, ideal for refining your documents and removing irrelevant content. Rotating PDF pages becomes a breeze, allowing you to correct the layout with just a few clicks. Additionally, our split and merge functionalities provide you with the flexibility to rearrange and combine PDF files accordingly.

extract.name: extract
extract.metaDescription: Advanced content extraction: Convert PDF to DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV, extract images, metadata, and FDF data efficiently.
extract.summary: Extract content and images from your documents at ease
extract.description: Our services are designed to meet the diverse needs of content extraction, whether for professional or personal use. Convert your PDFs into editable DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, or CSV formats with precision, making it easier to handle and repurpose your data. Our tool extracts images maintaining the quality of the original ones. Additionally, our service facilitates the extraction of PDF metadata, and form data in FDF format, ideal for data analysis and reporting.

ocr.name: ocr
ocr.metaDescription: Convert scanned documents to editable formats like DOCX, XLSX, TXT, and more. Make PDFs searchable with our advanced OCR technology.
ocr.summary: Turn Scans into Editable & Searchable Files
ocr.description: Our Optical Character Recognition technology transforms your scanned PDFs into editable and searchable formats with unparalleled accuracy. Whether you're converting to DOCX, XLSX, or TXT, our OCR solution ensures that your documents are easily editable. Additionally, we offer the capability to add a textual layer to scanned PDFs, making them fully searchable and allowing for efficient content extraction.

security.name: security
security.metaDescription: Enhance document security with password protection for DOCX, PPTX, and PDF files. Reliable encryption and decryption services.
security.description: Our services provide robust password protection for DOCX and PPTX files, ensuring that your sensitive information remains confidential and secure. In addition to protecting your documents, we also offer advanced PDF protection and decryption services. Secure your PDFs with a strong password to control viewing, printing, and editing, or use our decryption service to regain access to your protected PDFs with ease.

autocad.name: autocad
autocad.metaDescription: Export your DWG, DWF, DXF, DWGX, DWFX files to multiple image formats like JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, or even PDF documents programmatically using REST API.
autocad.description: Our REST API service is tailored for professionals who require quick and reliable conversion of AutoCAD files such as DWG, DWF, DXF, DWGX, and DWFX into various image formats like JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, or even into PDF documents. Whether you're an architect, engineer, or designer, our tool ensures that your detailed AutoCAD drawings are accurately represented in the format of your choice.

optimize.name: optimize
optimize.metaDescription: Master file optimization: Image/document compression, PDF flattening, rasterization and repair for enhanced performance.
optimize.description: A comprehensive suite of tools designed to enhance your files' efficiency and quality. Advanced image and document compression techniques to reduce file sizes without losing quality. Discover the power of PDF optimization through flattening and rasterization techniques, ensuring your documents are not only compact but also visually impeccable.

template.name: template
template.metaDescription: Create custom DOCX and PDF documents with our template-based solution. Inject values into placeholders for personalized output using REST API.
template.description: Our service is tailored for users who need to generate documents based on specific templates. Whether you’re preparing business reports, official letters, or any other type of document, our tool allows for the easy injection of custom values into pre-defined placeholders. This feature is particularly useful for businesses and individuals who require consistent document layouts with varying content.

compare.name: compare
compare.metaDescription: Effortlessly compare documents for changes using our fast and secure REST API service. Ideal for editing, collaboration, and document management.
compare.description: Our document compare tools are designed for anyone who needs to track changes and differences in text documents efficiently. It accurately highlights changes between different versions of a DOCX file, allowing you to easily see additions, deletions, and modifications. This feature is indispensable for ensuring consistency and accuracy in document editing and version control.

archive.name: archive
archive.metaDescription: Archive more than 100+ file formats to ZIP, encrypt with a password, and choose from different compression levels programmatically using REST API.
archive.description: Our archive converters are designed to handle over 100 different file formats, making it a versatile tool for a wide range of archiving needs. Archive your files securely with options for password encryption, ensuring that your data remains safe during transfer and storage. It allows for varying levels of compression as per your needs. Extracting files from ZIP archives is just as efficient and user-friendly!

office.name: office
office.metaDescription: Convert your MS Office documents with any programming language at ease using our fast and secure conversion service. A complete MS Office REST API.
office.description: A complete MS Office suite conversion REST API service. Easily convert to and from DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, RTF, TXT, CSV, PDF, and much more. Each conversion provides a bunch of useful conversion properties. Convert your MS Office documents with any programming language at ease using our fast and secure conversion service.

openoffice.name: openoffice
openoffice.metaDescription: A complete OpenOffice suite conversion REST API service. Easily convert to and from ODT, OTT, OTH, ODM, SXW, RTF, TXT, CSV, PDF, and much more.
openoffice.description: A complete OpenOffice suite conversion REST API service. Easily convert to and from ODT, OTT, OTH, ODM, SXW, RTF, TXT, CSV, PDF, and much more. Each conversion provides a bunch of useful conversion properties. Convert your OpenOffice documents with any programming language at ease using our fast and secure conversion service.

markdown.name: markdown
markdown.metaDescription: Efficiently convert HTM/HTML files to Markdown (MD) format, perfect for web developers and content creators.
markdown.description: Markdown REST APIs provide tools for converting HTM and HTML files to Markdown (MD) format. Our converters ensure that your HTML structures are accurately transformed into clean, concise Markdown syntax. Whether you're looking to streamline content management, simplify website updates, or convert web pages to a format that's easier to edit and version control, our HTML to Markdown conversion tools are here to help.

ebook.name: ebook
ebook.metaDescription: Convert your eBooks to a PDF document or image like PNG, JPG, TIFF, or WEBP programmatically using our fast and secure REST API with any programming language.
ebook.description: Convert your eBooks to a PDF document or image like PNG, JPG, TIFF, or WEBP programmatically using our fast and secure REST API with any programming language you choose. You can choose from a bunch conversion parameters when converting an eBook. Your eBook can be further compressed, encrypted or merged after you convert it to a PDF document.

html.name: html
html.metaDescription: Convert webpages, HTM, HTML, and MHML files to multiple destination formats like a PDF, PNG, JPEG, etc. using our fast and reliable REST API conversion service.
html.description: Convert webpages, HTM, HTML, and MHML files to multiple destination formats using our fast and reliable REST API conversion service. Converters allow multiple advanced options like converting websites that are secured with basic authentication, lets you inject your custom JS or CSS, hide adds, cookie consent dialogs and more.

spreadsheet.name: spreadsheet
spreadsheet.metaDescription: Efficiently convert between MS Office Excel and iWork Numbers formats. Seamless spreadsheet conversion for accurate data management.
spreadsheet.description: Our comprehensive tools cover a wide range of conversions, including from and to MS Office Excel and iWork Numbers formats. We also specialize in converting PDF files to XLSX, ensuring your data is editable and manageable. Need to present your Excel data in a universally accessible format? Convert your XLSX files to PDF with ease. Our services also extend to converting CSV files to XLSX and vice versa, perfect for handling large data sets.

publishing.name: publishing
publishing.metaDescription: Convert PUB, XPS, OXPS files to PDF, PNG, and more. Optimal solutions for all your publishing file conversion needs.
publishing.description: Our service caters to users of Microsoft Office Publisher, offering efficient and high-quality conversions of PUB files to popular formats such as JPG, PNG, TIFF, and PDF. In addition to that, we offer advanced conversion services for XPS and OXPS files conversion to PDF and PNG. Our conversion process retains the layout, design, and color integrity of your original files, ensuring that the essence of your work is preserved.

document.name: document
document.metaDescription: Effortlessly convert to and from various document formats. Reliable, fast, and accurate document conversion for all your Word needs.
document.description: Whether you're converting from textual documents to PDF, image, HTML, or vice-versa, our service guarantees fast, accurate, and reliable results. This is ideal for professionals who require quick turnarounds and high-quality document handling. In addition to basic format conversions, our tools also support advanced features to maintain formatting, styles, and layouts, ensuring that your documents look professional and remain consistent across conversions.

presentation.name: presentation
presentation.metaDescription: Transform presentations effortlessly with our REST APIs conversion tools. Convert PDF to PPTX, KEY to PPTX, and more with ease.
presentation.description: Specializing in a variety of PowerPoint conversions, our tools make it easy to transform your presentations. Key features include converting PDF files to PPTX format and converting KEY (Apple Keynote) files to PPTX, ensuring compatibility and ease of use across different platforms. Our advanced technology maintains the integrity of your original layout, graphics, and animations, making the conversion process smooth and reliable.

email.name: email
email.metaDescription: Secure and reliable email conversion REST API service, providing EML, MBX, MSG, and OFT file conversions to PDF, PDFA, or image with multiple parameters.
email.description: Secure and reliable email conversion REST API service, providing EML, MBX, MSG, and OFT file conversions to PDF, PDFA, or image. You can choose whether to convert email attachments or not. You can also choose if you want to include the email's metadata like from, to, subject, and date into the selected destination format.

image.name: image
image.metaDescription: A powerful image converter SDK for all programming languages. Convert BMP, FAX, GIF, HEIC, ICO, JPEG, MDI, PNG, TIFF, or WEBP files to PDF or image.
image.description: We support a wide range of image formats, including BMP, FAX, GIF, HEIC, ICO, JPEG, MDI, PNG, TIFF, and WEBP. Whether you need to convert these images to PDF for document inclusion or to other popular image formats for various uses, our tools are equipped to handle your requirements with precision. Additionally, our service offers the functionality to apply watermarks to your images, ensuring your content protection and personalization.

watermark.name: watermark
watermark.metaTitle: Watermark PDF API: Image, Text & PDF Overlay Stamps
watermark.metaDescription: Integrate REST watermark APIs to stamp PDFs with image, text, or PDF overlay marks. Control font, color, position, opacity, rotation, and page ranges.
watermark.summary: Stamp image, text, or PDF overlay watermarks on PDFs via REST API
watermark.description: Integrate watermark functionality into your applications via REST endpoints for stamping PDF documents. Apply image watermarks from PNG, JPG, or TIFF files. Add text watermarks with control over font, size, color, stroke, opacity, and rotation. Overlay another PDF page as a vector watermark across selected pages. Every request accepts precise placement parameters including coordinates, scale, page ranges, opacity, and clickable links. Use these endpoints to brand contracts, mark drafts as confidential, apply copyright notices, or automate batch document labeling inside your pipeline.

drawing.name: drawing
drawing.metaDescription: Effortlessly convert Microsoft Visio diagrams to PDF, JPEG, PNG, and TIFF. Preserve quality with our advanced conversion tools.
drawing.description: Converting drawings to various formats is streamlined and efficient. Our services are specifically tailored for professionals who utilize Visio for detailed diagrams and need versatile output options. Whether you need to convert your Visio diagrams to PDF for documentation purposes, JPEG or PNG for high-quality image formats, or TIFF for archiving and printing, our tools ensure that your diagrams maintain their integrity and quality.

forms.name: forms
forms.metaDescription: Streamline PDF forms and FDF file handling with our conversion tools. Extract and import form data effortlessly for efficient data management.
forms.summary: Efficient PDF & FDF Form Data Handling Tools
forms.description: Simplify your workflow by enabling efficient extraction and import of form data. Whether you're dealing with complex PDF forms or need to handle FDF files, our platform offers seamless, user-friendly solutions. Perfect for businesses and individuals who regularly work with form data, our tools ensure accuracy and save time. Enjoy the ease of extracting data from forms for analysis, or importing data into forms for quick completion.

ai.name: ai
ai.metaDescription: Leverage AI to automate content detection and transformation across file formats with our secure, efficient, and intelligent REST API solutions.
ai.description: Our AI-powered REST API automatically detects and transforms content across different file formats with advanced algorithms. From text redaction to document structuring, our intelligent solution simplifies complex tasks, ensuring efficiency and security without manual intervention. Streamline your document workflows and rely on AI for smarter, faster, and more accurate content processing.

barcode.name: barcode
barcode.metaDescription: Generate, detect, and decode high-quality barcodes and QR codes from data or documents with our REST API. Supports Code 128, QR Code, EAN-13, and more.
barcode.summary: High-Quality Barcode and QR Code Solutions
barcode.description: Generate high-quality barcode and QR code images from data, or detect and decode them from documents and images using our REST API. We support a wide range of industry-standard formats, including Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, QR Code, and Data Matrix. You can fully customize the generation process or use advanced detection algorithms to extract data from various file formats accurately.

post.description:
When source files require multiple conversions, optimizing performance is possible by uploading the file once and then performing multiple conversions without the need for re-uploading.
The uploaded file is securely stored on the convertapi.com server for a maximum period of 3 hours and can be accessed through a unique secret URL with a UUID.
In conversion requests, the file can be referenced using the File ID, which is generated upon successful file upload.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description:
File name.
Required if the header field `content-disposition` is not set.

parameters.name: content-disposition
parameters.description:
This header field is used to determine the file name.
**Required** if query parameter `filename` is not set.
Query parameter `filename` overrides this parameter.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: Custom ID for the file that is uploaded. Lowercase alphanumeric character string.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description:
Remote file URL. The URL of the file you want to upload and store on the ConvertAPI file server.
If the file is accessible by the URL, it can be uploaded directly from its location by passing the URL instead of the file itself.

parameters.name: headername
parameters.description: Remote file request header field name (used exclusively in conjunction with the `url` parameter).

parameters.name: headervalue
parameters.description: Remote file request header field value (used exclusively in conjunction with the `url` and `headername` parameters).

multipart/form-data.example:
There can be only one part with file data.
```http
[POST]
https://v2.convertapi.com/upload 
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----7MA4YWxkTrZu0gW

------7MA4YWxkTrZu0gW
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="my_file.doc"

--FILE DATA--
------7MA4YWxkTrZu0gW--
```

400.description: File request with an invalid file ID

415.description: The file type is not supported

500.description: Unable to store or download remote file

parameters.name: download
parameters.description:
- `attachment` - download a file
- `inline` - view file in a web browser

delete.description: If the file is no longer required it can be deleted. Otherwise, it will be automatically deleted after 3 hours.

get.description: The endpoint returns information about a user account. It is helpful to check the account balance status and other data. The endpoint can be authenticated only with a secret, the token is not accepted.
The endpoint that returns information about your usage statistics based on the date range.

SourceFormat.description: Source file format (docx, pdf, jpg etc.)

DestinationFormat.description: Destination file format (docx, pdf, jpg etc.)

/convert/ai/to/jpg.description: Convert Adobe Illustrator to JPG with color space, quality, resolution/DPI, scaling, and size control for predictable output.

StoreFile.description:
When the `StoreFile` parameter is set to `True`, your converted file is written to ConvertAPI’s encrypted, temporary storage and made available via a time-limited secure download URL, valid for up to 3 hours. After this period, the file is permanently deleted.

When `StoreFile` is set to `False`, conversion happens entirely in-memory. The raw file bytes are streamed back in the API response without touching disk or external storage, ensuring maximum security and zero persistence so that only you can access the content.

File.description: File to be converted. Value can be URL or file content.

FileName.description:
The `FileName` property defines the name of the output file(s) generated by the file conversion API, ensuring safe and
unique file naming. It sanitizes input filenames to remove potentially harmful characters, automatically appends the
correct file extension based on the target format, and includes an indexing feature to distinguish multiple output files
from a single input. For example, converting `report.docx` to PDF format might result in `report.pdf` for a single file,
or `report_0.pdf`, `report_1.pdf` for multiple files, ensuring each output file is uniquely identifiable.

ImageResolution.description: Set output image resolution in dpi.

ScaleImage.description: Scale the output image. If ScaleImage is False output document will be stripped to ImageHeight / ImageWidth, if ScalePage is True output document will be scaled to ImageHeight / ImageWidth.

ScaleProportions.description: If set to true, the barcode will be generated using recommended proportions based on the larger dimension.

ScaleIfLarger.description: Scaling only if the input image is larger than the output.

ImageInterpolation.description: Specifies whether the image parser should use image interpolation. Enabling image interpolation will result in higher quality for scaled images at the expense of speed.

ConversionCost.description: This amount will be deducted from your balance after the conversion.

Content-Type: application/octet-stream

--FILE CONTENT--
--43cf1475-ab15-4c6b-b5ee-e2cbcedfe92f--

GradientStep.description: Controls how gradient transitions are divided into color steps.

SegmentLength.description: Sets the average length of path segments. Effective only when `CurveMode` is set to **Spline**.

SpliceThreshold.description: Defines the threshold for merging adjacent short path segments into longer ones. Effective only when `CurveMode` is set to **Spline**.

/convert/images/to/join.x-ca-overview-markdown:
The Join Images API enables you to **merge multiple images** into a **single composite image** with customizable
properties. 

You can specify the **space between images** in pixels and choose a **space color**.
The **join direction** property lets you determine whether the images are combined **vertically** or **horizontally**.
Additionally, you can set the output format of the merged image to **jpg**, **png**, or **tiff**.

The Join Images API is useful for creating cohesive photo collages or visual presentations by seamlessly merging
multiple images with customizable gaps and orientation.

- **Form** - Extracts structured data from standard forms containing predefined fields, ideal for surveys, applications, and questionnaires.

PageSegmentationMode.description:
The **PageSegmentationMode** parameter specifies how the OCR engine segments and interprets text within PDF documents. Choosing the appropriate mode enhances OCR accuracy by aligning closely with your document's layout and structure.

Select one of the available modes to control text detection and layout analysis:
- **SparseText** - Detects as much text as possible without enforcing any specific order. Suitable for documents containing scattered or fragmented text.
- **SparseTextOsd** - Similar to SparseText, but also includes orientation and script detection (OSD). Useful for documents with rotated text or multiple scripts and languages.
- **Auto** - Automatically selects the best segmentation mode based on document content. Ideal for general documents with mixed or unknown layouts.
- **AutoOsd** - Combines automatic segmentation with orientation and script detection. Recommended for documents with uncertain text orientation or multilingual content.
- **SingleColumn** - Assumes a single column of text with varying text sizes. Best suited for straightforward layouts.
- **SingleLine** - Treats the entire image as a single line of text. Useful for single-line labels, banners, or narrow text snippets.
- **SingleWord** - Treats the entire image as a single word. Ideal for recognizing isolated words or short phrases.

Preset.description:
The Preset parameter determines the type of sensitive data the AI will detect and redact from the document. It complements the `RedactionData`, enabling you to refine or expand the redaction criteria. Select `manual` to use your customized redaction options exclusively.

Choose a preset to define the type of sensitive data the AI will detect and redact from the document:

- **Auto** - Automatically detects and redacts sensitive data across all categories, including PII, financial, healthcare, legal, and confidential information. Best for general redaction when the document type is unknown or contains mixed data.

- **GDPR** - Redacts personal data as required by GDPR, including names, emails, IP addresses, phone numbers, and national IDs.

- **HIPAA** - Ensures compliance with HIPAA by redacting protected health information (PHI) such as patient names, medical record numbers, diagnoses, and prescription details.

- **FERPA** - Redacts personally identifiable student information to comply with FERPA, including student names, school records, and educational identifiers.

- **FOIA** - Prevents the exposure of sensitive personal or national security data in documents released under FOIA. This includes classified content, addresses, and government IDs.

- **GLBA** - Complies with GLBA by redacting financial data such as bank account numbers, credit card details, loan records, and investment information.

- **CCPA** -Meets CCPA requirements by removing consumer personal data such as purchase history, geolocation, contact details, and online identifiers upon request.

- **Manual** - Disables automatic AI detection preset. Only the manually set parameters will be used to determine what should be redacted. Ideal for users who want full control over redaction without AI-based automation.

ContextSize.description:
Defines how the AI engine processes the document in terms of context.

When the `ContextSize` parameter is set to `Page`, each page is processed independently, without context from other pages. This mode is useful when a document contains structured or repetitive data (such as tables with rows of values), or when a high volume of detections is expected. By limiting context to a single page, the AI avoids confusion from unrelated content and ensures accuracy per page.

When the `ContextSize` parameter is set to `Balanced`, the AI maintains context across multiple pages while still optimizing processing efficiency. This mode is recommended for large or multi-page documents where relationships between sections matter, and it also provides improved performance for large documents.

RedactionColor.description: Specifies the color used to mask redacted text, accepting formats such as Hexadecimal (e.g., `#FFFFFF` for white or `#FF5733` for orange), RGB with an optional alpha channel (e.g., `255,255,255` for white or `255,255,255`), and named colors (e.g., `white`, `red`, `blue`).

RedactionThickness.description:
The RedactionThickness property controls the height of the redaction stroke line relative to the original line height.

- A value of 1 means the stroke height matches the original line height.
- Values less than 1 (e.g., 0.5) reduce the stroke height.
- Values greater than 1 (e.g., 1.5 or 2) increase the stroke height.

PII.description: **Personally Identifiable Information (PII)** - Detects and redacts common personal identifiers, including names, email addresses, phone numbers, birthdates, and home addresses.

PHI.description: **Patient Health Information (PHI)** - Detects health-related information such as patient names, medical records, insurance details, and prescription data.

Financial.description: **Financial Data** - Focuses on financial records, including credit card numbers, bank account numbers, financial transaction details, etc.

Legal.description: **Legal and Contractual Data** - Detects legal and contractual terms, including case numbers, legal clauses, signatures, and confidential agreements.

Confidential.description: **Legal and Contractual Data** - Detects proprietary business information, contracts and agreements, internal communications, trade secrets, intellectual property details, and sensitive corporate data.

MinimumConfidence.description: Sets the minimum confidence threshold for AI-based detection of sensitive data. Higher values reduce false positives but may miss subtle matches.

SplitByPattern.description: A comma-separated sequence of positive integers defining the size of each split segment. The PDF will be divided into consecutive chunks whose page counts follow the given pattern, repeating it until all pages are consumed. For a 10-page PDF with `SplitByPattern = 3,2`, the output will be four documents containing pages `[1-3]`, `[4-5]`, `[6-8]`, and `[9-10]` (pattern repeats: 3,2,3,2).

SplitByRange.description: Specify exactly which pages to extract by listing single pages or inclusive ranges. The API will emit one PDF per entry, in the order given. For a 10-page file with `SplitByRange = 1-3,5,7-9`, you receive three PDFs containing pages `[1–3]`, `[5]`, and `[7–9]`.

SplitByTextPattern.description: Splits the PDF into separate output files by starting a new document at each page whose text matches the specified regular expression. With `SplitByTextPattern = Chapter\s+\d+`, the PDF will be split at every page where “Chapter 1”, “Chapter 2”, etc., appear. If “Chapter 1” is on page 1, “Chapter 2” on page 10, and “Chapter 3” on page 20 of a 25-page PDF, you’ll get four files containing pages `[1–9]`, `[10–19]`, `[20–25]`, and any pages after the last match (if present).

SplitByBookmark.description: Automatically splits a source PDF into individual documents, creating a new file at every bookmarked page. When nested bookmarks are present, splitting occurs at the deepest (child) level, and each output file is named to reflect the full bookmark hierarchy - for example: `ParentBookmark-ChildBookmark.pdf`. When the source PDF has no bookmarks, the original document is returned unchanged as `no-bookmarks.pdf`.

ExtractPages.description: Specify a comma-separated list of pages or inclusive ranges `ExtractPages = 1,3-5,7` to pull out from the source PDF. The API will emit one PDF per entry, each containing exactly the pages defined.

MergeOutput.description: When set to `true`, all split output files (whether defined by page ranges, custom ranges, or text-pattern segments) will be merged into a single PDF. By default `false`, the API returns one PDF per specified range.

Invoice identification:

* `{{DocumentType}}` — human-readable document type, resolved from UBL `cbc:InvoiceTypeCode`: `380` → `INVOICE`, `381` → `CREDIT NOTE`, `384` → `CORRECTED INVOICE`. Other codes are emitted verbatim.
* `{{InvoiceNumber}}` — UBL `cbc:ID` (e.g. `INV-2025-001`).
* `{{IssueDate}}` — UBL `cbc:IssueDate` (e.g. `2025-03-12`).
* `{{DueDate}}` — UBL `cbc:DueDate` (e.g. `2025-04-11`).
* `{{Currency}}` — UBL `cbc:DocumentCurrencyCode` (e.g. `EUR`, `USD`).
* `{{BuyerReference}}` — UBL `cbc:BuyerReference` (e.g. `PO-12345`).
* `{{Note}}` — UBL `cbc:Note`.

Parties (supplier from `cac:AccountingSupplierParty`, customer from `cac:AccountingCustomerParty`):

* `{{SupplierName}}` / `{{CustomerName}}` — `cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:RegistrationName`, falling back to `cac:PartyName/cbc:Name`.
* `{{SupplierVatId}}` / `{{CustomerVatId}}` — first non-empty `cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID`.
* `{{SupplierAddress}}` / `{{CustomerAddress}}` — composed from `cac:PostalAddress` as `StreetName, CityName, PostalZone, Country` (empty parts skipped).

Contact (rendered inside `{{#IF ShowContactDetails}} ... {{#ENDIF ShowContactDetails}}`):

* `{{SupplierContactName}}` / `{{CustomerContactName}}` — `cac:Contact/cbc:Name`.
* `{{SupplierContactPhone}}` / `{{CustomerContactPhone}}` — `cac:Contact/cbc:Telephone`.
* `{{SupplierContactEmail}}` / `{{CustomerContactEmail}}` — `cac:Contact/cbc:ElectronicMail`.

Totals (from `cac:LegalMonetaryTotal` and `cac:TaxTotal`):

* `{{TaxExclusiveAmount}}` — net total before tax.
* `{{TaxAmount}}` — total VAT amount.
* `{{PrepaidAmount}}` — amount already paid.
* `{{PayableAmount}}` — final amount due.

Payment (from `cac:PaymentMeans/cac:PayeeFinancialAccount`):

* `{{PayeeIBAN}}` — account `cbc:ID`.
* `{{PayeeAccountName}}` — account `cbc:Name`.

#### Conditional sections

Wrap optional content in the template so it can be toggled via the `ShowContactDetails` and `ShowNote` parameters. The wrapper tags themselves are removed from the rendered output:

* `{{#IF ShowContactDetails}} ... {{#ENDIF ShowContactDetails}}` — kept when `ShowContactDetails` is `true`; the whole block is removed when `false`.
* `{{#IF ShowNote}} ... {{#ENDIF ShowNote}}` — kept when `ShowNote` is `true`; removed when `false`.

#### Table placeholders

Place each table placeholder in a single cell of a one-row template table — the row is cloned for each item, preserving formatting.

* `{{InvoiceLines}}` — one row per `cac:InvoiceLine`. Columns (in order): Description, Quantity, Unit Price, VAT %, Line Amount.
* `{{VatBreakdown}}` — one row per `cac:TaxTotal/cac:TaxSubtotal`. Columns (in order):
    * VAT Category label — `VAT {percent}%` for rated categories (e.g. `VAT 21%`), or a descriptive label with UNTDID 5305 code for non-rated ones: `Standard rate (S)`, `Zero-rated (Z)`, `Exempt (E)`, `Reverse charge (AE)`, `Intra-community (K)`, `Export (G)`, `Out of scope (O)`, `Canary Islands IGIC (L)`, `Ceuta/Melilla IPSI (M)`.
    * Tax Amount with currency (e.g. `73.50 EUR`).
    * Rate % (e.g. `21%`, `8.5%`).
    * Taxable Amount.

correct file extension based on the target format, and includes an indexing feature to distinguish multiple output files
from a single input. For example, converting `report.docx` to PDF format might result in `report.pdf` for a single file,
or `report_0.pdf`, `report_1.pdf` for multiple files, ensuring each output file is uniquely identifiable.

ScaleIfLarger.description: Scaling only if the input image is larger than the output.

ImageInterpolation.description: Specifies whether the image parser should use image interpolation. Enabling image interpolation will result in higher quality for scaled images at the expense of speed.

ConversionCost.description: This amount will be deducted from your balance after the conversion.
